result:
The fix is PR #2731, merged as commit `1f4098170806704451ed195a9922dc1a30ebcedc` under ticket O3-5958. The form's queue location default now reads the location the Service Queues dashboard already resolved, and falls back to the session location only when nothing is stored.

**Why it was blank:** the form defaulted `queueLocation` to `sessionLocation?.uuid` alone. A login location that isn't queue-tagged has no matching option in the dropdown, so the field rendered empty. The dashboard header (`queue-location-header-title.component.tsx`) already walks up to the nearest queue-tagged ancestor and stores it via `updateSelectedQueueLocationUuid` (`store.ts:45-47`). The form never read that stored value.

**The fix**, in `packages/esm-service-queues-app/src/create-queue-entry/queue-fields/`:
- `queue-fields.component.tsx:68` pulls `selectedQueueLocationUuid` from `useServiceQueuesStore()`.
- `queue-fields.component.tsx:81` changes the default to `selectedQueueLocationUuid ?? sessionLocation?.uuid ?? ''`.
- `queue-fields.test.tsx:224-238` adds two tests: one prefills from the store, and one falls back to the session location when the store is empty.

The PR went through several rounds. An earlier version used a `useEffect` and was dropped after review (reviewer dkayiwa). The commit message's bullet list still describes that earlier version, so the diff is the reliable description of the change. The merged diff touches only the two files above.
